einzeiler: Why 12 personnel packages with Pat Freiermuth and Darnell Washington are key for the…
kurzfassung: The Pittsburgh Steelers could leverage 12 personnel formations with tight ends Pat Freiermuth and Darnell Washington to unlock their offense. Head coach Mike McCarthy has historically favored three-receiver sets, but similar dual-tight-end packages proved successful in Dallas and Seattle. Meanwhile, rookie right tackle Maxi Ihanachor is being pushed to secure a starting role following roster changes.
stichpunkte: Mike McCarthy traditionally relies on 11 personnel but successfully deployed 12 personnel with two tight ends in 2022.
Pat Freiermuth and Darnell Washington provide the Steelers with valuable versatility at the tight end position.
The use of two tight end sets has surged across the NFL since 2018 as a counter to two-deep safety coverages.
Balanced offensive play-calling will be crucial for Aaron Rodgers and the Steelers to keep defenses guessing.
Rookie Maxi Ihanachor is facing pressure to develop quickly and take over the starting right tackle job.
Dylan Cook filled in admirably last season but struggled against elite competition, making a long-term upgrade necessary.

clips.hook: Using tight ends to exploit lighter defensive coverages
clips.text: Deploying two quality tight ends creates mismatches that allow the offense to run directly at nickel defenses when opponents anticipate a pass.

clips.hook: The significant rise of 12 personnel across the league
clips.text: The usage frequency of dual tight end packages grew by roughly 30 to 40 percent between 2018 and 2025 as a natural tactical adjustment.

clips.hook: Creating a nightmare matchup for opposing defenses
clips.text: Pairing two exceptionally large tight ends creates massive mismatch problems for defenders while simultaneously strengthening the ground game.

clips.hook: Shifting toward a more nimble offensive line
clips.text: The offensive line philosophy has evolved away from pure power blocking toward athletic movement and speed in space.

clips.hook: The urgency behind the rookie tackle's development
clips.text: Following previous roster moves and investments, the coaching staff urgently needs their young offensive tackle to step up and succeed.

beschreibung:
Christopher Carter of the Pittsburgh Post-Gazette, hosts the Locked on Steelers podcast.
The Pittsburgh Steelers' offense has plenty of playmakers, but could their secret weapon be 12 personnel packages with Pat Freiermuth and Darnell Washington? Christopher Carter shows what he's learned from talking to Mike McCarthy, Freiermuth and Washington about the Steelers' offense. While many will focus on DK Metcalf and Germie Bernard, Chris feels the tight ends may end up being the group that dismantles defenses the most.
Also, Chris thinks the Steelers are going into overdrive to get Max Iheanachor ready for the regular season opener. Will he be ready? Or will Dylan Cook be the team's starting offensive tackle across from Troy Fautanu.

Finally, Chris shows his talk with Rayshawn Jenkins, and how the Steelers safeties look to be a physical unit. But will they be able to protect against the deep ball?
